$$

The first non-zero entry of each row (from left to right) is the leading entry.

$$
A=\begin{bmatrix}0 & -3 & 0 & 4 \\ 0 & 0 & 5 & 2 \\ 2 & -1 & 0 & 7 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 1\end{bmatrix}
$$

So, the answer is $-3+5+2=4.$
